# Maintenance Pass

> How the periodic maintenance pass works: run wiki lint,
> reconcile the index, and append a log entry.

## Steps

1. Run the lint script and read every finding.
2. Fix broken links and stale summaries.
3. Append a `lint | maintenance pass` entry to the log.

> A later blockquote: this is a note, not the summary.

## Cadence

The pass runs weekly. A missed pass shows as overdue on the console. Each pass reviews pages, links, summaries and tags, and records what it changed.

# Wiki Lint Checks

> Wiki lint checks frontmatter, index coverage, log format, broken links, orphan pages, duplicate titles, summary length, tag hygiene and lineage fields across every published page in the wiki tree.

Each check reports a finding with the page path. The checks run before every commit.
